sourceChecks.text: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raama, Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

profileDecisionJa: クシュの系譜の中で、ラアマの子としてデダンとともに名が記されています。

wikipediaReadEvidence.locator: Article lead, lines 117–121; says Sheba was a son of Raamah and notes a later country/people association.
wikipediaReadEvidence.support: The article’s genealogy corresponds to the “sons of Raamah: Sheba” wording in 1 Chronicles 1:9; it also discusses geographic interpretations, so this link is related context rather than an independent biography.
wikipediaReadEvidence.decision: Related article only; no claim that all later Sheba/Sheba people uses designate this person.
